visual_action: A montage of clips showing Donald Trump in various presidential and campaign settings (speaking at a podium, walking through the White House, meeting military personnel, visiting a fast-food restaurant). These are intercut with numerous short clips of diverse, unnamed individuals speaking to the camera.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is shown in various clips while multiple people in the audio refer to him as their hero.

cast.name: Unnamed supporters
cast.evidence: Multiple different people appear in short clips, all stating that 'Trump is my hero'.

spoken_summary: A compilation of many different voices, layered over a beat, repeating the phrase "Trump is my hero." Variations include "Trump, you're my hero" and "Trump is my hero president."
audio_music: A continuous, rhythmic hip-hop style beat plays throughout the entire video, driving the pace of the montage.
editing_pacing: A fast-paced montage with rapid cuts between different video clips, timed to the background beat.
central_claim: Donald Trump is viewed as a hero by a diverse group of everyday Americans.
intended_effect: To create a sense of widespread, popular adoration for Donald Trump and to foster pride and a sense of community among his supporters.
